name: Aoshigure
source:
A short story about walking home from the station with a close friend.

As August drew to a close, Sasaki, now a working adult, felt a touch of nostalgia.
He walked home with Aoi, a high school girl he was close to, reminiscing a little about their summer memories.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/10535]Novelgame[/url]]
